title: Add author, title, year, edition, publicDomainBasis to NUMEROLOGY_METHOD_CITATIONS (AC-22-01)
spec:
Update `app/src/core/book-citations.ts`:
1. Extend `MethodCitation` with:
   - `author: string`
   - `title: string`
   - `year: number | string`
   - `edition: string`
   - `publicDomainBasis: string`
2. Populate these 5 fields on `chaldean` (Cheiro / Count Louis Hamon, Book of Numbers, 1926, Public Domain pre-1928 / >60 yrs post-1936), `pythagorean` (Sepharial / Walter Gorn Old, The Kabala of Numbers, 1911, Public Domain), and `katapayadi` (Traditional South Indian Katapayadi Sankhya Canon, Classical, Public Domain traditional mathematical cipher).
3. Preserve ALL existing exports, types, `NUMEROLOGY_METHOD_CITATIONS` fields, and all 27 entries of `NAKSHATRA_CANONICAL_ATTRIBUTES` verbatim without dropping any.
